blog_posts.title: Cleanup vs Facial: Which One Does Your Skin Actually Need?
blog_posts.excerpt: They are not the same treatment, and booking the wrong one is the most common reason people feel a session 'didn't do much'.
blog_posts.author: Seema Nanda
blog_posts.content:
## The short answer

A cleanup focuses on removing dirt and impurities. A facial does that too, but then goes further — it hydrates, nourishes and rejuvenates the skin.

If your skin feels congested, if you can see blackheads around the nose, if you have had a long gap between appointments — a cleanup is the reset. If your concern is dullness, dehydration, pigmentation or early fine lines, a cleanup will not touch it. You need a facial built around that concern.

## What a cleanup does

A cleanup is a shorter, focused service: cleanse, gentle exfoliation, steam, extraction, a soothing pack. Our Lotus Cleanup purifies pores and restores brightness using botanical extracts. The O3+ Whitening Cleanup adds an oxygen-infused brightening step. Lotus Puravital is the option we reach for when skin is oily and needs detoxifying without irritation.

Booked once a month, a cleanup is maintenance. It keeps pores clear between the bigger treatments.

## What a facial does

A facial adds the treatment layer — actives, masks, serum infusion, and in the advanced protocols, technology. Hydra Facial cleanses, exfoliates and infuses serums in one multi-step session. Casmara Prestige uses a signature peel-off mask for instant luminosity. Upendice Anti-Ageing works with peptides to firm and reduce fine lines.

This is where visible change happens, and it is why we analyse skin before recommending one.

## How to decide

Ask yourself what you want to be different when you leave. Cleaner? Book a cleanup. Brighter, firmer, more even, more hydrated? Book a facial, and let the consultation decide which one.

## How often

For healthy, glowing skin, once every 3–4 weeks is the rhythm — for either service. Skin turns over on roughly that cycle, so treating in step with it is what compounds results.

If you are not sure which column you fall into, call us. Two minutes on the phone saves you booking the wrong thing.

blog_posts.title: What Actually Happens During a Hydra Facial
blog_posts.excerpt: A step-by-step walkthrough of our most requested facial — and an honest answer to whether the glow lasts.
blog_posts.author: ESTEQO
blog_posts.content:
## Why it is the one people ask for

Hydra Facial is our most loved multi-step facial because it does several jobs in a single session: it deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and infuses serums for instant radiance. It uses hydra-dermabrasion and LED therapy rather than harsh scrubbing, which is why it suits skin that reacts badly to traditional exfoliation.

## Step by step

**1. Analysis.** Nothing starts until your skin is assessed. Serum selection depends on it.

**2. Cleanse and vortex exfoliation.** A gentle vacuum-based tip lifts dead cells and loosens congestion.

**3. Extraction.** The same suction clears pores without the pressure of manual extraction, which is the part sensitive skin usually dreads.

**4. Serum infusion.** Hydrating and brightening actives are pushed in while pores are open.

**5. LED therapy.** Calms and finishes the session.

For sensitive or acne-prone skin we often start with the Hydra Clean-Up instead — non-invasive, chemical-free, with vacuum-based extraction.

## Where it goes from there

If you want more than hydration, the Hydra Facial is the base for a family of treatments:

- **Hydra + Glow Peel** — a glow-enhancing peel added to the Hydra steps, with cryo therapy and LED.
- **Hydra + Carbon Laser Facial** — brightening carbon laser paired with hydrating Hydra therapy.
- **Advanced Hydra Facial** — lymphatic drainage, BB Glow and meso needling for deeper rejuvenation.

## Does the glow last?

Honestly: a single session gives you a few days of visible glow. The change that lasts comes from a course, spaced roughly 3–4 weeks apart, so each session builds on the last. Anyone promising permanent results from one appointment is selling you something.

## Aftercare

No makeup for 6–8 hours. Sunscreen, without exception. Skip active acids at home for 48 hours.

blog_posts.title: Laser Hair Reduction: What to Expect Before, During and After
blog_posts.excerpt: Medical-grade laser targets hair at the root to permanently reduce regrowth. Here is the realistic version of how that goes.
blog_posts.author: Seema Nanda
blog_posts.content:
## What the treatment does

Laser hair reduction removes unwanted hair from face and body, delays and reduces future growth, and treats ingrown hair and razor bumps. Skin is left smoother, softer and clearer. Our system is suitable for all skin types, with settings adjusted after assessment.

## Who it suits

Anyone looking for a long-term alternative to waxing or shaving. It is particularly worth it if you have sensitive skin that reacts to waxing with redness, bumps or ingrown hair, or if you simply want smooth skin with minimal maintenance.

## Before your session

Shave the area 24 hours before — do not wax or thread, because the laser needs the follicle intact. Avoid sun exposure and self-tan in the days beforehand. Come with clean skin, no makeup or deodorant on the treatment area.

## During

Sessions are quick and comfortable. Cooling technology protects your skin throughout. Most people describe it as a warm snap rather than pain.

## After

No downtime — you can resume activities immediately. Mild warmth or pinkness settles within a few hours. Sunscreen on any exposed treated area is non-negotiable.

## The part people underestimate

Hair grows in cycles, and laser only affects follicles in the active phase. That is why reduction is gradual and planned across multiple sessions rather than delivered in one. Your session count and spacing get set during consultation, based on the area and your hair type — not from a generic package.

blog_posts.title: Brow Mapping: Why Shape Comes Before Hair Removal
blog_posts.excerpt: Most brow regret starts with someone removing hair before deciding on the shape. Mapping reverses that order.
blog_posts.author: Seema Nanda
blog_posts.content:
## Your brows frame your entire face

At ESTEQO the brow department focuses on enhancing your natural brow shape, filling sparse areas, correcting asymmetry and creating long-lasting definition through professional brow design.

All of that starts with mapping.

## What mapping actually is

Brow mapping is a precise measuring and shaping session that maps your ideal brow structure to your facial proportions — before any hair is removed. We measure the start point, the arch and the tail against your bone structure and eye placement, mark them, and only then shape.

It is non-invasive, there is no discomfort, and it is the step that creates symmetry rather than hoping for it.

## Why it matters more than the technique

Microblading, powder brows, lamination, tint — every one of them is applied *to a shape*. If the shape is wrong, the technique cannot save it. And a brow that has been over-shaped takes months to grow back into a position where it can be corrected.

This is the single most common thing we correct in Brow Correction & Colour Removal appointments: good pigment work sitting on a shape that never suited the face.

## Before you book anything semi-permanent

Ask to be mapped first. See the shape drawn on before committing to pigment. Any brow artist confident in their work will be happy to do this.

blog_posts.title: The Japanese Head Spa Is More Than a Scalp Massage
blog_posts.excerpt: Warm cleansing, aromatherapy steam, pressure-point work and a nourishing mask — the ritual, and what it does for your scalp.
blog_posts.author: ESTEQO
blog_posts.content:
## A ritual, not a rinse

Our Japanese Head Spa is a holistic scalp and hair rejuvenation therapy inspired by ancient Japanese wellness rituals. It combines gentle massage, aromatic steam and nourishing hair care to refresh your mind, revive your scalp, and leave hair naturally healthy and glossy.

## What it does

- Relieves stress, tension and mental fatigue
- Improves blood circulation to the scalp
- Promotes healthier, shinier, smoother hair
- Reduces headaches, eye strain and sleep issues
- Detoxifies the scalp and removes product buildup

That last point is the one people notice first. Dry shampoo, styling product and hard water leave a film that ordinary washing does not fully clear.

## The sequence

Warm scalp cleansing, aromatherapy steam, a slow rhythmic head massage, pressure-point stimulation, and finally a nourishing mask with a hydrating hair treatment.

## Who should book it

Anyone dealing with stress or anxiety. Anyone with a dry, itchy or sensitive scalp. People experiencing hair fall or weak roots. And anyone who needs deep relaxation and better sleep more than they need another product.

## Pair it

It sits well after a facial, when your skin is already calm and you have nowhere to be.

blog_posts.title: How to Prepare for Your First Appointment at ESTEQO
blog_posts.excerpt: Every service begins with a detailed skin consultation. A little preparation makes that consultation much more useful.
blog_posts.author: ESTEQO
blog_posts.content:
## We plan after analysis, not around trends

Every service at ESTEQO begins with a detailed skin consultation, which lets our specialists understand your needs and recommend the right solution. The more accurate the picture you give us, the better that recommendation is.

## Bring this with you

**Your current routine.** Photograph the actual products — the labels tell us about actives, not just brands.

**Any recent treatments.** Peels, laser, threading, injectables. Timing matters; some treatments cannot be layered within a few weeks of each other.

**Medication and skin history.** Isotretinoin, blood thinners, a history of keloids or cold sores all change what is safe.

**Your actual goal.** "Even tone for a wedding in eight weeks" gives us a plan. "Good skin" does not.

## On the day

Come without makeup if you can. Avoid sun exposure and strong exfoliating actives for 48 hours beforehand. Allow a little more time than the service length for the consultation itself.

## After

You will leave with a protocol, not just a treatment. Aftercare and the spacing of your next appointment are part of the result — following them is what makes the difference between one good day and lasting change.

Call or WhatsApp +91 8010135135 if anything changes before your slot.
